title: M2 Profile authority decisions for discovery, draft and promotion
goal: Record accepted D11-D14 decisions that separate inert discovery, non-authoritative drafting, reviewed Target governance and immutable Profile composition.
acceptanceCriteria: V4-AD-039 limits discovery to deterministic inert observations and prohibits build, restore, download, target-code execution and policy inference.
Profile drafts remain StateRoot-owned non-authoritative data while reviewed active sources and immutable compositions have distinct authority locations.
Generated recommendations cannot silently resolve gate, severity, exception, baseline, unsupported-coverage or ambiguous Module choices.
Promotion requires validation, hashes, fixtures, coverage, human policy decisions, review and applicable target trust authorization.
V4-TODO-020 tracks implementation without claiming that the accepted decision is implemented.
No product code, contract, test, workflow, ruleset, package, consumer repository or remote state changes occur.
risks: Discovery recommendations could be mistaken for accepted project policy.
A generated draft could be mistaken for executable or installed authority.
Profile promotion could be mistaken for CI activation or permission to mutate a consumer repository.
decisions: D11 accepts a deterministic inert discovery allowlist and preserves unknown or ambiguous observations.
D12 accepts StateRoot-owned drafts, Target-owned reviewed sources and immutable sibling compositions as separate layers.
D13 accepts generated facts and labelled recommendations while reserving policy choices for explicit human decisions.
D14 accepts validation, fixtures, coverage, review and target authorization as promotion prerequisites.
